description: A two-panel composite figure of X-ray diffraction data. (a) shows three vertically offset XRD patterns of the three Fe-C-Cr-Mn-Si alloy samples, plotted as Intensity (a.u., no numeric scale printed) versus 2θ from 20 to 100° with 10° tick spacing. Sample 1 (blue) is labelled Fe-Cr and its reflections are indexed (1 1 0), (2 0 0) and (2 1 1); Sample 2 (orange) and Sample 3 (pink) are both labelled Fe-Cr-Ni and show the same three reflections, with (2 0 0) and (2 1 1) very weak. The dominant (1 1 0) peak lies just below 45°. (b) is the enlargement of the (1 1 0) region over 2θ = 40-50° (2° ticks): a vertical dashed line labelled "Fe" marks the standard Fe reference position, and dash-dot lines labelled "Fe-Cr" are drawn at each sample's peak maximum. All three sample peaks sit to the right of the dashed Fe line, i.e. shifted to higher 2θ. The figure's argument is that the three alloys share a single bcc-type Fe-Cr(±Ni) solid-solution phase and that the systematic right-shift of the (1 1 0) reflection relative to standard Fe evidences lattice distortion from Cr/Ni substitution. Note the citing text calls the peaks 100/200/211, whereas the panel labels read (1 1 0)/(2 0 0)/(2 1 1).

observations.observation: Panel (a) contains three superimposed, vertically offset XRD patterns labelled Sample 1 (Fe-Cr), Sample 2 (Fe-Cr-Ni) and Sample 3 (Fe-Cr-Ni), plotted against 2θ from 20 to 100° (ticks every 10°).
Only three reflections are indexed in panel (a): (1 1 0) at roughly 44-45°, (2 0 0) near 65° and (2 1 1) near 82°; the (1 1 0) peak dominates each pattern.
The intensity axis of both panels is labelled 'Intensity (a.u.)' with no numeric tick values, so absolute or relative intensities cannot be quantified from the images.
Panel (b) expands the 40-50° range with 2° tick spacing and contains a dashed vertical reference line labelled 'Fe' plus dash-dot lines labelled 'Fe-Cr' marking each sample's peak position.

In panel (b) the peaks of Sample 1, Sample 2 and Sample 3 are all located to the right (higher 2θ) of the dashed 'Fe' reference line, i.e. the alloy reflections are shifted to higher angle than standard Fe.
Panel (b) shows the (1 1 0) peaks of Samples 2 and 3 as broader and of lower apparent height than that of Sample 1.
The caption states that the figure presents the XRD patterns of three samples (a) and the enlarged peaks at 40-50° (b).
The citing text states that the mass percentages of the three Fe-C-Cr-Mn-Si alloy samples are listed in Table 6; the figure itself does not display any composition values.

The citing text states that Sample 1 has a main Fe-Cr phase and that with increasing Ni content the main phase transfers to Fe-Cr-Ni, consistent with the Fe-Cr and Fe-Cr-Ni labels printed in the panels.
The citing text attributes the right-shift of the diffraction peak relative to standard Fe to atomic radius differences between Cr, Ni and Fe causing lattice distortion.
Discrepancy: the citing text names the diffraction peaks 100, 200 and 211, whereas the labels printed in panel (a) read (1 1 0), (2 0 0) and (2 1 1).
No numeric 2θ value is printed at any peak maximum in either panel; peak positions can only be read relative to the axis ticks and the dashed reference lines.
The citing text states the alloy is FCC-based, with Cr atoms randomly substituting Fe atoms in the FCC lattice, which is what the single set of three reflections in panel (a) is used to support.

subfigures.description: Stacked XRD patterns of three samples over 2θ = 20-100° (10° ticks), y-axis 'Intensity (a.u.)' with no numeric values. Sample 1 (blue) is labelled Fe-Cr; Sample 2 (orange) and Sample 3 (pink) are labelled Fe-Cr-Ni. Peaks are indexed (1 1 0) at ~44-45°, (2 0 0) near 65° and (2 1 1) near 82°; no other reflections are labelled.

Enlarged view of the (1 1 0) reflection region, 2θ = 40-50° with 2° ticks. A vertical dashed line labelled 'Fe' marks the standard reference; dash-dot vertical lines labelled 'Fe-Cr' mark the peak maximum of each sample. The three sample peaks (Sample 1, Sample 2, Sample 3) all lie to the right of the Fe line.

unreadable_items: Panel (a) and (b): no numeric tick values on the 'Intensity (a.u.)' axis, so peak intensities/heights are not quantifiable
Exact 2θ positions of the (1 1 0), (2 0 0) and (2 1 1) peaks are not printed; the dashed 'Fe' and 'Fe-Cr' reference-line positions are not numerically labelled
Sample compositions (mass percentages) are not shown in the figure (referred to Table 6)
